ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's account for review of the "I'm Here" arrival tap made outside the pickup radius + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat consists only of a pickup arrangement, a location query and a cancellation notice; no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

Facts: rider booked Bugis Junction → Tanjong Pagar Centre (RydeX, fixed fare). Driver cancelled at 12:09:25 as a "no-show". Driver had pressed "I'm Here" at 12:06:15.

NS-1 requires all of (i) "I'm Here" pressed, (ii) GPS places the driver within 200 m of the pickup at that moment, (iii) once pressed, continuous waiting at the pickup for more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01) until cancellation.

(ii) fails. Pickup is (1.2994, 103.8555); the GPS sample at the tap (12:06:00, ~30 s grid, 15 s before the tap) is (1.304756, 103.854869). Latitude difference 0.005356° ≈ 595 m, longitude 0.000631° ≈ 70 m → ~599 m from the pickup point — roughly 3× the 200 m radius. All later samples (12:06:30 → 12:09:25) sit at the same spot (1.30476–1.30477, 103.85486–103.85489, speed 0–2 km/h), i.e. the driver waited stationary ~600 m away, near the eastern end of Jalan Besar, not at Bugis Junction. The rider's own chat message ("I'm at the pickup point, no car here") is consistent with the trace.

The 12:06:00→12:09:25 stretch has 30 s sampling on a 30 s grid with no gaps, so (iii) is in fact satisfied (~3 min 25 s from the tap). But NS-1 is conjunctive: failing (ii) means the no-show fee does not stand. Under NS-2 the $6.61 must be refunded in full.

Additionally, because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him well outside the pickup radius, NS-2's fraud clause applies → flag_account (this is the account-review action of NS-2 itself; RD-6 is not cited since it concerns route-deviation cases, and the profile may not decide the case anyway).

Profile facts (driver: 1 prior no-show dispute upheld in 90 d) support the account review but do not determine this ruling.

Evidence status: sufficient — the GPS trace covers the whole tap-to-cancel window with regular sampling and settles the distance element; the cancellation fee amount ($6.61) is recorded in the fare breakdown.

Amount: full refund of the disputed item = $6.61 (NS-2; issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7).

rejected_claims.reason: Claim of having pressed 'I'm Here' and waited at the pickup is contradicted by the GPS trace: the 12:06:00–12:09:25 samples place the car ~599 m from Bugis Junction, outside the 200 m arrival radius required by NS-1(ii). System records override statements.
